why_this_file_exists: The bar is written down and committed BEFORE any structural-feature model is trained.
This project has had three wrong conclusions caught by pre-registration and at least two
numbers published that reconciled with a belief rather than being recorded. Declaring the
threshold in advance is the cheapest guard either failure has.
question: Do structural features (import graph + file inventory) fix cross-ecosystem transfer, which more ecosystems alone did not?

population.name: gold set #2 packet
population.status: FRESH ecosystems - never in any training corpus
population.note: Coverage needs no ground truth, so measuring here does NOT spend the blind set. The 250 human labels remain unread and reusable.

metric.name: coverage
metric.definition: (predictions not in abstainOn + round(abstained * suAdmitFraction)) / n

baseline.what: frozen corpus-v2 model, PATH-ONLY features, K1' FAIL

PRIMARY.means: structural features beat path-only on the same 250 files. The ADR's premise is supported.

SECONDARY.means: K1' passes. The tier is viable on fresh ecosystems.

TERTIARY.means: the class prior has not collapsed. Teacher uses 13.

GUARD.means: improvement on fresh ecosystems was not bought by degrading the in-distribution case.

always_report: per-repo: hono and trpc separately - K1' is a property of (model, repo), not of the model
coverage split by isolated vs connected files (25.9% of hono's and 8.9% of trpc's eval rows are touched by no import edge)

stopping_rule.selection: Normaliser, block scale and any other choice are selected on TRAIN-CV ONLY (Phase 3).
stopping_rule.evaluation: Gold set #2 is touched ONCE per candidate configuration, in Phase 4, after selection is frozen and committed.
stopping_rule.forbidden: Selecting a configuration by its gold-set-#2 score. That is how a held-out number becomes a training signal.

model_config_fixed.why: Identical to the frozen v2 spec, so Phase 4 measures the FEATURE SPACE and not a re-tune. Changing two things at once has already cost this project a result it had to discard.

failure_action.if_PRIMARY_fails: Publish the negative. Do NOT harvest (Phase 5 does not run). Write the ADR amendment. The premise would be measured wrong, and 15 more repos would not fix a feature-space problem - which is exactly the mistake corpus v1 made.
failure_action.if_PRIMARY_passes_SECONDARY_fails: Premise supported, bar not reached. Harvest is then justified ON EVIDENCE: ecosystems and features are additive levers.

parity_control.requirement: Before the new harness reports ANY number about ANY new model, it must reproduce the committed baseline on the frozen v2 model with path-only features.
parity_control.rationale: A new instrument that cannot reproduce the old instrument's result on the old input is not measuring the same thing.
parity_control.mandatory_flag: --max-old-space-size=6144 (the frozen artifact stores a recipe, not weights; nine 4096-unit refits OOM at node's ~2096 MB default)

known_traps_that_invalidate_any_number_h: ELM.train() does not train on what you pass it - the repo's smoke test scores 83% with no data. Use trainFromData(X, y) with explicit one-hot y.
An OOM exits 0 with an empty table. Assert the results table is populated; never trust the exit code.
Seed defaults to 1337 - pass it explicitly per repeat or 'independent' models are byte-identical.
A 13-class softmax caps confidence near 0.245, so absolute thresholds select nothing. Percentile only.
Coverage is agreement-shaped, not accuracy: the teacher is 72.3% against truth and is NOT shown the path only.
